paras: Herbert's supple skink (Subdoluseps herberti), also known commonly as Herbert's writhing skink is a species of lizard in the subfamily Lygosominae of the family Scincidae. The species is native to Malaysia and Thailand.
The specific name, herberti, is in honor of English ornithologist E.G. Herbert, who worked in Siam (Thailand).
The preferred natural habitat of S. herberti is forest.
The mode of reproduction of S. herberti is unknown.
